namespace Volo.Abp.Cli.Commands.Tests; public class LoginCommandTests { private readonly Mock> _mockLogger; private readonly LoginCommand _loginCommand; public LoginCommandTests() { _mockLogger = new Mock>(); _mockLogger.SetupAllProperties(); // Create dependencies with mocks var mockAuthService = new Mock(); var mockCancellationTokenProvider = new Mock(); var mockRemoteServiceExceptionHandler = new Mock(); _loginCommand = new LoginCommand( mockAuthService.Object, mockCancellationTokenProvider.Object, mockRemoteServiceExceptionHandler.Object ) { Logger = _mockLogger.Object }; } [Fact] public async Task HasMultipleOrganizationAndThisNotSpecified_ShouldLogError_WhenMultipleOrgsExist() { // Arrange var commandLineArgs = new CommandLineArgs { Target = "testuser" }; var organization = ""; // Act var result = await _loginCommand.HasMultipleOrganizationAndThisNotSpecified(commandLineArgs, organization); // Assert _mockLogger.Verify( x => x.Log( LogLevel.Error, It.IsAny(), It.Is>((v, t) => v.ToString().Contains("multiple organizations")), It.IsAny(), It.IsAny, Exception?, string>>()), Times.Once); Assert.True(result); } [Theory] [InlineData("Invalid username or password")] public async Task LogCliError_ShouldLogSpecificMessage_ForInvalidCredentials(string exceptionMessage) { // Arrange var ex = new Exception(exceptionMessage); var args = new CommandLineArgs(); // Act _loginCommand.LogCliError(ex, args); // Assert _mockLogger.Verify( x => x.Log( LogLevel.Error, It.IsAny(), It.Is>((v, t) => v.ToString() == "Invalid username or password!"), It.IsAny(), It.IsAny, Exception?, string>>()), Times.Once); } [Theory] [InlineData("RequiresTwoFactor")] public async Task LogCliError_ShouldLogSpecificMessage_ForTwoFactorRequired(string exceptionMessage) { // Arrange var ex = new Exception(exceptionMessage); var args = new CommandLineArgs(); // Act _loginCommand.LogCliError(ex, args); // Assert _mockLogger.Verify( x => x.Log( LogLevel.Error, It.IsAny(), It.Is>((v, t) => v.ToString().Contains("Two factor authentication is enabled")), It.IsAny(), It.IsAny, Exception?, string>>()), Times.Once); } [Fact] public void LogCliError_ShouldLogExceptionMessage_WhenNoSpecialCasesMatch() { // Arrange var ex = new Exception("Some other error message"); var args = new CommandLineArgs(); // Act _loginCommand.LogCliError(ex, args); // Assert - Tests the specific LogError call on line 137 _mockLogger.Verify( x => x.LogError("Some other error message"), Times.Once); } [Fact] public void LogCliError_ShouldLogHtmlErrorMessage_WhenHtmlPageContainsError() { // Arrange var htmlErrorPage = @"

Test Error Message

"; var ex = new Exception(htmlErrorPage); var args = new CommandLineArgs(); // Act _loginCommand.LogCliError(ex, args); // Assert _mockLogger.Verify( x => x.LogError("Test Error Message"), Times.Once); } } ``` ```
